name: Motorised tools & small appliances
note: Operation groups move between plants together. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: Motor-fan assembly
operations: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel
stack laminations and wind the rotor
press-fit the fan to the motor spindle

groups.name: PCBA (SMT)
operations: SMT placement and reflow of the printed circuit board assembly

groups.name: Heating element
operations: wind resistance wire around a core fitted with ceramic pipes
insert the core into a mica-insulated metal tube

groups.name: Housing moulding
operations: injection-mould the housing shells and covers

groups.name: Switch, cord and minor parts
operations: make the switch, power cord, wiring, supports and fasteners

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: connect wiring, mount the PCBA and motor, close the housing
